description: The same gap the TypeScript frontend had, on the other language: `or` carried no value, so the most common way Python writes a default dropped taint at the last hop before the sink. The walrus is here because it binds and carries at once. The parameterized route is the negative that matters -- the value still passes through a default, and it reaches an argument the statement does not interpret, so it is not a finding.

expected.note: interpolated into the statement after passing through `or`; low because the cursor receiver does not resolve in this frontend
